How It Works: Uses physical features of a device
Advantage: Low resource use and unique device identity
Limitation: Can be affected by temperature, voltage and ageing
Common Tests: Authentication time, reliability, uniqueness and error rate

How It Works: Uses ECC, hashing, encryption and key exchange
Advantage: Good balance between security and resource use
Limitation: Many studies use simulation instead of real devices
Common Tests: Processing cost, communication cost, authentication time and security

Advantage: Helps manage device identity and trust
Common Tests: Time, storage, communication cost and scalability

How It Works: Uses device behaviour, wireless signals and other device information
Advantage: Can give extra information for authentication
Limitation: Needs more data and processing power
Common Tests: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score and false-positive rate
